title: Semrush Competitors Scraper
description: Find organic competitors for a domain with Authority Score, estimated monthly visits, and Semrush Rank. Batch domains in one run to map competing sites or prioritize SEO analysis.

batch.title: Domains
batch.description: Domains for which to find organic search competitors.
batch.valueDescription: domain used to run this search.

schema.description: Root domain or subdomain to analyze

storeCopy.seoDescription: Find Semrush organic competitors for a domain with authority scores, estimated visits, and ranks. Map competing websites and guide SEO analysis.
storeCopy.intro: Submit domains to retrieve sites Semrush associates with organic search competition. Compare each domain’s authority, estimated visits, and rank.
useCases: SEO specialists can identify competing domains for a client website.
Agencies can rank possible competitors by estimated traffic and authority.
Growth teams can expand site-analysis lists with relevant competing domains.
howToUse: Add one root domain or subdomain to `domains` for each comparison.
Set `maxResults` to cap competitor rows across the batch.
Sort the dataset by authority, visits, or Semrush rank.

faqs.question: Are visits measured values?
faqs.answer: Visits are Semrush estimates and should be treated as directional competitor metrics.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Competing website domain identified for the searched site.

fields.name: authority_score
fields.description: Semrush Authority Score reported for the competing domain.

fields.name: visits
fields.description: Estimated monthly visits for the competing website.

fields.name: semrush_rank
fields.description: Semrush global rank assigned to the competing domain.

fields.name: input_domain
fields.description: Website domain used to find this competitor.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this competitor record was collected.
